verdict.rationale: RudderStack's pipelines run continuously in the background once configured. Examples include no-code warehouse-to-SaaS pipelines, continuous consent syncing, in-flight transformations and alerts on data issues. Its AI features (the Rudder AI Slack agent and the MCP server) are documented only as interactive, natural-language tools, not as autonomous agents that act on their own. Missing for 10: AI-driven autonomous or scheduled agent automations, background agent runs without a human prompt, any trigger/scheduling docs for AI actions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
